source_read: https://www.burgerandlobster.com/locations/london/bond-street/menu/ plus the other nine UK menu pages (Bread Street, Knightsbridge, Leicester Square, Mayfair, Oxford Circus, Threadneedle Street, West India Quay, High Street Kensington, Brighton), all downloaded fresh 2026-10-08 (robots.txt: Crawl-delay 10 honoured, /dish/ never fetched); Bond Street also rendered in headless Chromium
notes: Re-running the script on the fresh pages reproduces data/source exactly (only checked_on would move), so data/source was not rewritten. All 52 published calorie figures re-read with an independent regex parser and as rendered text: every one is on the Bond Street page, each size/option line included, and the only printed figures not published are the documented unlisted ones (Rock Oysters 40, three two-value Add lines, set-menu repeats). The other nine pages agree on every figure except the B&L Ice Cream Sandwich (Brighton 928 for a different recipe, already excluded in the notes). Calories-only chain, the site publishes no allergen information. Tags match dish wording; 'Combo for Two' is left untagged because its text says 'original burger' without naming the beef (the same page names the Original Burger's beef): a documented script rule, not changed.
